body.text: Applications are admitted only within either of these UTC windows: at or after 2026-11-03T08:00:00.000Z but strictly before 2026-11-08T20:00:00.000Z; or strictly after 2026-11-12T16:00:00.000Z and at or before 2026-11-17T23:59:59.999Z. Within a window, an applicant qualifies if either (1) age is at least 14 but under 18, guardian consent is present, and the applicant is a resident or is both a student and not a member; or (2) age is at least 18, and the applicant is either a resident without a scholarship, or a student who satisfies at least one of these two conditions: being a member, or having no scholarship. All other applications are rejected. For admitted applicants only, use the first matching fee in this priority order, in USD cents: scholarship 1800; member 3600; age under 18 2900; student 4800; otherwise 6400. Rejected applicants have no fee.
